Definition: perhaps from G3201; a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful person:--blemish.
BiblicalUsage: Momos is a blemish, a blot — Peter calls the false teachers spots and blemishes, revelling in their own deceivings while they feast with the church.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the blot is the tell: what looks like fellowship but feeds itself is a stain on the table.
